The generated hook output schemas embedded in that binary define pre-tool-use.command.output with hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext, and permission-request.command.output without it: every level of the permission-request schema sets additionalProperties false, and its only model-visible string, decision.message, is read on deny alone. A PermissionRequest response carrying an unknown field is rejected as invalid permission-request JSON output, so the note waits for the next PreToolUse instead.
